title: Bids
description: View and manage bids on task requests.

help.title: About Bids
help.overview: A bid is a provider's proposal on a task request: amount, currency, delivery days, and a written proposal. Pending bids can be accepted or rejected. Accepting one awards the task and starts an order.

sections.title: Statuses
items: Accepted — this bid won; the task request becomes awarded.
Rejected — declined or withdrawn; other pending bids are rejected automatically when one is accepted.

sections.title: Accept and reject
items: Accept marks the bid accepted, rejects every other pending bid on the same task, sets the task request to awarded, and creates a pending order between requester and bidder.
Reject (or withdraw) sets that bid to rejected only.
Only a pending bid can be accepted or rejected.
sections.body: These are actions on a pending bid, not ordinary field edits.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create posts a new bid against an open task request.
Use the row or sheet actions for accept and reject.
Soft-deleted bids can be restored when permitted.
